inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing Before Eating: A child was observed to be seated and served breakfast upon entering the room, before washing their hands.   *Noted this was corrected during the inspection when the child was instructed to wash their hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §746.3417(1))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: In a classroom with children under two years of age and were eating breakfast, children were observed watching Bluey.   *Noted this was corrected during the inspection when the TV was turned off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: An infant was asleep in a restrictive device.     *Infant was moved into the crib during the inspection*
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A two year old child was alone on the playground for less than a minute.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: It was determined through an investigation that the operation did not report in a timely manner when they were notified of a possible minimum standard violation on April 4th, but did not report until four days later on April 8th.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: The fire extinguisher in the van designated for transporting children was found to be unsecured
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: Transportation binders did not include medical authorizaton for the children being transported.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): One of the ten staff files did not have a pre-employment form available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Two of the ten children's files reviewed did not have current immunization records for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child: Transportation binders did not include telephone numbers for parents/authorized individuals.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: It was determined in the investigation that caregivers were using prohibited punishment by yelling at children in their care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: On the three year old playground, in the play structure there was an active hornet nest.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Sufficient Number of Toys: In an infant aged classroom, there was not a significant amount of toys to keep the children engaged.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Sufficient Number of Toys (26 TAC §746.2405(5))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: In the 3 and older playground the slide exit did not have the required 6 inches of loose fill installed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: The fire extinguishers in the vans used to transport children had not been serviced since 2016 and 2020.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: The first aid kit utilized in the transportation van did not inlcude the following items; a guide, scissors, or tweezers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policies did not include information regarding Promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services: The operationaal policies did not incldue information regarding  Procedures for supporting inclusive services to children with special care needs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §746.501(a)(30))

occurrences.finding: Required Vehicle Documentation - date of lease or purchase for each vehicle: Purchase information for a transporation vehicle  was not present at the operation at the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Vehicle Documentation - date of lease or purchase for each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5627)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Caregivers were not practicing proper supervision while caring for children during nap time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: Two cribs with children under 12 months had a stuffed animal in the crib while there was an infant using the crib.   Noted: This was corrected immediatly when the toys were removed from the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: In a room with a ratio of one caregiver to four children, a caregiver was alone with five children.   Noted: This was corrected immediately when another caregiver was brought into the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Five of the reviewed children's files did not have maintained vaccination records included in the file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: Two infants were found to be sleeping in restrictive devices.   Noted: This was corrected at time of the inspection, when the infants were removed from the restrictive devices and places on their backs in their cribs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: The director did not have a completed training in administering medications or responding to emergencies due to food or allergic reactions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The electrical cord to a bottle warmer was hanging down over the sink, accessible to infants.   Noted: This was corrected at inspection when the cord was moved out of reach of the infants.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Employees Discipline Own Children: Information gathered for this investigation determined a staff member inappropriately disciplined their own child while at the operation. Staff member slapped the child on the side of their face and spanked the child?s bottom. Staff member also yelled at the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employees Discipline Own Children (26 TAC §746.2807)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver placed a non-walking infant on a lawn chair resulting in the infant to lean forward and fall off the chair. The infant hit their face on the ground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Toys Choking Hazard: A bottle filled with water gel beads did not have the cover secured posing a chocking hazard in the infant II classroom .
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Toys Choking Hazard (26 TAC §746.2415(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Handwashing Procedures: Caregiver in toddler classroom sprayed the hands of a toddler with soapy water while toddler was laying on the diaper changing table. The cleaning solution sting  the child's eye.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Handwashing Procedures (26 TAC §746.3419)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Relate to Children: During an investigation it was reported that a caregiver expressed frustration and used inappropriate language towards children.    Note: The deficiency was corrected at inspection / investigation when the Director made the decision to release caregiver of her duties.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Relate to Children (26 TAC §746.1201(2))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Prompt Attention to Needs: This standard was reviewed in relation to the allegation and found to be deficient as the child's diaper had not been checked or changed for more than three hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Prompt Attention to Needs (26 TAC §746.2401(4))

occurrences.finding: Administering Medication - Only to Child for Whom Intended: During the investigation, it was found that a caregiver administered a prescription cream to the sibling of the child who it was prescribed to without a proper prescription at the parents' request.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Administering Medication - Only to Child for Whom Intended (26 TAC §746.3805(b)(2))
